**No, not under the current rules.** The rules file makes `is.waiwai.dictation` permanent because macOS ties Accessibility grants to the bundle identifier. A new identifier means every existing user loses that permission and must re-grant it manually. Sparkle also expects updates to keep the same bundle ID, so existing installs likely couldn't auto-update to the renamed app.

To get the OpenRamble name without the cost, change only the display name (`CFBundleDisplayName` / product name) and keep the bundle ID.

If you still want the new identifier, you'd first need to change the invariant in the rules file. I haven't checked the repo, so I can't tell whether any users have installed the current build yet.
